messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial bridge fee & implementation SLA

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, here’s a concise proposal to bridge Lighthouse Health from evaluation to a production purchase without slowing your procurement timeline. Goal is to give your team runway for integration and a clear conversion mechanism so ROI is protected.

High-level proposal (we can iterate):
- 60-day time-boxed pilot (extension to 90 days available if integration milestone met)
- One-time bridge fee: $25,000 payable at SOW signature
  - Converts 100% to platform credits if Lighthouse signs an annual contract within 90 days of pilot completion
  - Otherwise $10,000 refundable after contractual close on a pro-rata basis (see SOW section 4.2)
- Implementation SLA during pilot: 4-hour L1 response, weekly syncs, and a dedicated solutions engineer for the first 30 days
- Data handling: Redwood retains KV/prefix cache only for the session; we propose a 30-day log retention default (can be shortened per your security team)

Attached: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx and draft SOW (v1) for your lawyers.

Next steps: If this looks reasonable, Laura can produce SOW v2 with the escrow/legal language your procurement asked for. Happy to hop on a quick call this afternoon.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx, Lighthouse_SOW_v1_draft.docx
From: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lighthousehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial bridge fee & implementation SLA

Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick notes from procurement and legal:
- Procurement will prefer the bridge fee to be placed in escrow and released on conversion; they asked whether Redwood can accept DocuSign escrow instructions.
- Can the refundable piece be clearer? We need the exact trigger for refund (e.g., signed contract vs. paid first invoice).
- Security wants SLOs called out in the SOW (response times + escalation path) and confirmation that logs are deletable on request.

Happy to accept a redline of the SOW v2. If you can share SOW v2 and the pricing grid with the escrow language, procurement will review and route to legal.

—Maya
Maya Ortiz
Director of Product Operations, Lighthouse Health
procurement@lighthousehealth.com

Subject: Re: Trial bridge fee & implementation SLA — proposed compromise

Hi all —

To move this forward quickly, heres a practical compromise wed be comfortable with from a commercial and operational standpoint:

1) Fee structure
- Bridge fee: $25,000 at SOW signature.
- Conversion mechanics: 100% converts to annual contract credits if Lighthouse signs an annual MSA and pays the first invoice within 90 days after pilot end.
- Extended conversion window: if signed between 91–180 days, 50% converts to credits / 50% refundable.

2) Pilot duration & uplift
- Standard pilot: 60 days. If integration milestones A (ingest), B (end-to-end inference), and C (QA sign-off) are met within 45 days, well automatically extend to 90 days at no extra cost.

3) SLA & implementation
- L1 response: 4 hours (business hours), L2 within 24 hours.
- Dedicated solutions engineer for first 30 days, weekly status reports, and one integration workshop included.

4) Escrow & legal
- We can route the bridge fee to an escrow agent via DocuSign. To speed procurement, well accept a short escrow addendum in the SOW rather than add a lengthy side letter.

Next steps: Laura will update the pricing grid to show the convert/ refund scenarios (attached) and circulate the SOW v2 with the escrow clause. If Lighthouse procurement is comfortable, we can get signatures this week and spin up the implementation team next Monday.

Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Strategy — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx

If you can push SOW v2 with those two clarifications and the DocuSign escrow link, we will circulate internally and aim to return a signed MSA within the 90-day window. Procurement has assigned Jacob Lin as lead for the transaction; he is CC'd here.

Happy to sign off quickly once legal sees the minor tweaks.
